Gender: Roughly two-thirds of women (70%) disapprove of Trump's performance. Men lean unfavorable toward Trump, with 60% disapproving and 35% approving.

Age: Roughly two-thirds of voters aged 18-34 (74%) disapprove of Trump's performance, followed by 70% of 35-49-year-olds, 59% of 50-64-year-olds and 58% of those 65 and older. [...] According to Civiqs, last updated August 12, Trump's net approval in New Jersey stood at -35%.

New Jersey tilts unfavorable overall. About 65% of New Jersey residents polled currently disapprove of the president's performance.About 30% approve and another 5% did not choose either.

Education: Respondents across all education levels disapprove of Trump’s job per
results.title: A new low for Trump approval rating triggered by ongoing war with Iran
